edition.reason: Woolf: "Violets came and daffodils." The added "then" imposed a sequence the source does not state.

edition.old: Prue Ramsay died of an illness connected with childbirth.
edition.new: Prue Ramsay died of some illness connected with childbirth.
edition.reason: Woolf: "in some illness connected with childbirth". "some" keeps the report's vagueness about what the illness was.

edition.old: Meddling like this in their cosmos, she drove them into a frenzy of indecision.
edition.new: Meddling like this in the making of their world, she drove them into a frenzy of indecision.
edition.reason: Woolf: "this interference in their cosmogony". Cosmogony is the making of a world, not the world itself ("cosmos"); the plain phrase keeps Lily's mock-creator role.

edition.old: —well, it would need seeing to, that it would.
edition.new: —it would need seeing to, it would.
edition.reason: Woolf: "it would want seeing to—it would." Restores her echo; "well" and "that it would" amplified the dialect.

edition.old: The books and all were gone moldy,
edition.new: The books and things were moldy,
edition.reason: Woolf: "The books and things were mouldy". "and all were gone moldy" amplified the dialect.

edition.old: the carpet was ruined, clean ruined.
edition.new: the carpet was ruined, quite ruined.
edition.reason: Woolf: "the carpet was ruined quite." Her own postponed "quite" replaces the added rustic intensifier "clean".

edition.old: But folks should come and see for themselves;
edition.new: But people should come and see for themselves;
edition.reason: Woolf: "But people should come themselves". "folks" was added dialect.

edition.old: She’d never be wanting _them_ again. Dead, they said she was; years back, in London.
edition.new: She’d never want _them_ again. She was dead, they said; years ago, in London.
edition.reason: Woolf: "She would never want _them_ again. She was dead, they said; years ago, in London." Removes the added progressive and inversion; keeps the italics and an ordinary contraction.

edition.old: (a pitiful sight the garden was now, run wild, rabbits scuttling out at you from the beds)
edition.new: (the garden was a pitiful sight now, all run wild, and rabbits scuttling out at you from the beds)
edition.reason: Woolf: "(the garden was a pitiful sight now, all run to riot, and rabbits scuttling at you out of the beds)". Restores her word order and "all"; the inversion was added.

edition.old: (Went very sudden at the end, they said.)
edition.new: (She had died very sudden at the end, they said.)
edition.reason: Woolf: "(She had died very sudden at the end, they said.)" The subjectless euphemism "Went" was added; Woolf's own "very sudden" stays as her marker of Mrs. McNab's speech.

edition.old: just as they left it, oh dear, dear!
edition.new: just as they left it, ah dear!
edition.reason: Woolf: "ah dear!" The doubled "dear, dear" amplified it. Woolf's own "ah" is kept: it is Mrs. McNab's sigh, distinct from Mrs. Ramsay's "Oh dear!" at 40.9 (independent verification R1, defect 27.0-1).

cards.old: A bracketed passage reports that she died the summer after her wedding, of an illness connected with childbirth.
cards.new: A bracketed passage reports that she died that summer, within months of her May wedding, of some illness connected with childbirth.
cards.reason: "the summer after her wedding" can be read as a year later. Woolf reports the wedding "that May" (25.1) and the death "that summer" (25.3): the same summer. "some illness" matches the corrected 25.3.

threads.old: Another reports that she died that summer of an illness connected with childbirth.
threads.new: Another reports that she died that summer of some illness connected with childbirth.
threads.reason: Consequential consistency with LH-FU-2: the modern-en summary keeps the same vagueness as the corrected text and card.

semantics: Coordinates are chapter.index (chapter 1-based, paragraph index 0-based). Each old string must occur exactly once in its target string and is replaced by new. Serialization of every JSON file: json.dumps(indent=1, ensure_ascii=False) plus a trailing newline, as in the base package.
